question: Which of the following longitudes is considered as the International Date Line?
solution:
The correct answer is __**180º**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **180º longitude** is considered the International Date Line.
 
• The International Date Line is an imaginary line on the Earth's surface that roughly follows the 180º longitude.
